steps.en: Install the PyTorch audio stack (the repo ships no pip package — clone it and import)
steps.zh: 装 PyTorch 音频依赖并 clone 仓库（无 pip 包）

steps.en: Download one of the six checkpoints from Hugging Face
steps.zh: 从 Hugging Face 下载检查点

steps.en: Build the model from the config baked into the checkpoint
steps.zh: 用检查点里自带的配置把模型原样建出来

steps.en: Turn each utterance into 80-dim Mel filterbank features
steps.zh: 把每段音频转成 80 维梅尔滤波器组特征

steps.en: Feed the features to the model
Run CNN-Transformer blocks; the mixture-of-experts router activates only part of the expert sub-networks
steps.zh: 过 CNN-Transformer 各层，混合专家路由器只激活一部分专家子网络

steps.en: Pool the frames and project them to one fixed-size speaker embedding (192-dim by default)
steps.zh: 池化后投影成一个定长说话人向量（默认 192 维）

steps.en: Compare two embeddings with cosine similarity and pick your own threshold
steps.zh: 两段音频各取向量，余弦相似度一比，阈值自己定

value.en: No training, no labels, no serving stack — a speaker check is two embeddings and one cosine; the only knob left is your threshold
value.zh: 不用训练、不用标注、不用服务栈——声纹比对就是两个向量一次余弦，剩下的唯一旋钮是你自己的阈值

sources: https://github.com/ant-research/AntSpeaker README (Quick Start: pip install torch torchaudio soundfile; hf download AntResearch/AntSpeaker mect_b2_vc2.pt; create_model(ckpt["config"]["model"]); kaldi.fbank(waveform * (1 << 15), ...); model(fbank.to(device)); F.cosine_similarity(emb1, emb2))
https://github.com/ant-research/AntSpeaker antspeaker/models/model.py (VPR forward: backbone -> pooling -> BN -> linear; embed_dim default 192)
